fact: After the Riyadh global AI governance assembly of 15 May 2024, the national digital agency ANADEN wrote that AI is only at its first stirrings in the Comoros and that it will advise government on the measures and strategies needed to govern the technology nationally.
title: L'Assemblée Mondiale sur la Gouvernance mondiale de l'Intelligence Artificielle à Riyad
publisher: Direction Nationale de Cyber Sécurité - Comores
